scope: untuned immutable PostgreSQL search-generation and publication scaffolding

requirements.requirement: All five searchable projection types use one bounded, non-authoritative, immutable envelope with exact canonical revision and truth references
A build uses one exact W1 immutable revision membership and reconciles every projection obligation, visibility outcome, reference, and checksum
Two builds from the same W1 and projector inputs have identical checksums, independent of generation identity and input order
Incremental projection chunks converge byte-for-byte with a complete full projection and conflicting chunks fail closed
Generation lifecycle is building to validated to published to retired or rejected; failed builds cannot alter the live pointer
Publication history, seven-component transition, and singleton pointer switch are atomic and rollback restores retained N-1
Cursors and hydration remain pinned to an immutable publication/generation, are bounded and signed, and require restart after retention or safety revocation
Public search uses PostgreSQL FTS/GIN, normalized indexed facets, keyset pagination, capped candidates, and capped exact-revision hydration without JSONL or Worker corpus scans
Production-like query plans and latency/resource SLOs pass the frozen workload gate
Ranking quality, synonyms, authority priors, negative constraints, near-miss policy, and graph expansion meet frozen section 23 thresholds
WP2 evaluator, metric, cohort, and benchmark semantics remain frozen before any tuning

The final 20-item holdout runs once only after candidate freeze, under independently verified custody and authorization, with an authenticated evaluator and an aggregate-only terminal receipt contract
WP1 v1/static compatibility and rollback sources remain byte-for-byte pinned
Reviewed SQL becomes migration 0010 only after migrations 0004 through 0009 freeze and passes clean/N-1 PostgreSQL migration tests

USHSO recommends and explains public-source research options but never executes analyses, calculates market share, emits financial benchmarks, fetches source payloads, or silently merges uncertain identities
The successor search implementation has a versioned package surface, exact workspace dependencies, immutable content manifest, and non-mutating test/validate entry points

external_gates.reason: Migrations 0004 through 0009 are owned by active predecessor work; db/** was not modified.
Only psql/pg_isready clients are installed; no local initdb/postgres server was available, and no external database was contacted.
No production-like 30-minute 2x workload or measured latency receipt was fabricated.
This delivery is intentionally untuned and reports FAIL_PRE_TUNING.
